products.text:
Type: window pane wall mirror
Use: reflecting light, decorating a wall; living room, bedroom, entryway, above a console or dresser
Style: industrial, farmhouse, rustic
Materials: metal frame with distressed antique finish, mirror glass
Colors: antique grey, muted blue-grey
Shape: tall rectangle with rounded corners, cross mullions dividing four panes like an old window, slim frame, medium size, light visual weight
Feel: vintage, relaxed, airy
Goes with: weathered wood, white or grey walls, black iron accents; farmhouse or industrial rooms

Type: geometric gold wall mirror
Use: decorating a wall, reflecting light; living room, bedroom, entryway, above a console or sideboard
Style: glam, art deco, contemporary
Materials: gold-finished metal wire frame, mirror glass
Colors: warm gold
Shape: elongated octagon, wide open wireframe border of diamond and hexagon facets around a cut-corner rectangular mirror, medium-large, light and open
Feel: glamorous, sparkling, graphic
Goes with: white or navy walls, velvet, marble, brass accents; glam or art deco rooms

Type: round black metal sunburst mirror
Use: decorating a wall, statement piece; living room, bedroom, entryway, above a sofa or console
Style: bohemian, modern, contemporary
Materials: black metal wire frame with small gold joints, mirror glass
Colors: black, gold accents
Shape: small round mirror in a large open floral frame of overlapping petal-shaped loops, round outline, light and airy, large overall
Feel: graphic, artistic, airy
Goes with: white or light walls, rattan, plants, brass accents; bohemian or modern rooms

Type: rectangular overlay wall mirror
Use: decorating a wall, reflecting light; living room, dining room, bedroom, above a sideboard or fireplace
Style: traditional, glam, classic
Materials: champagne gold painted frame and fretwork overlay, mirror glass
Colors: champagne gold, pale warm beige
Shape: large rectangle with a raised oval and stepped Greek-key-like fretwork overlay over the glass, flat profile, substantial size
Feel: elegant, refined, light
Goes with: cream or soft grey walls, crystal, upholstered furniture; traditional or glam rooms

Type: rectangular brass frame mirror
Use: decorating a wall, checking outfits; bedroom, living room, entryway
Style: modern, minimalist, mid-century modern
Materials: brass-finished metal double-layer frame, mirror glass
Colors: warm brass, bronze
Shape: tall simple rectangle, slim deep shadow-box frame with two layers, clean edges, medium size, light visual weight
Feel: clean, warm, understated
Goes with: walnut wood, white or green walls, black accents; modern or mid-century rooms

Type: distressed wood wall mirror
Use: decorating a wall, reflecting light; bedroom, living room, entryway, above a dresser
Style: farmhouse, rustic, traditional
Materials: wood frame with distressed white paint, mirror glass
Colors: warm white, cream, hints of brown
Shape: tall rectangle with curved concave pagoda-like top shoulders, narrow molded frame, chipped edges, medium size, light
Feel: vintage, soft, charming
Goes with: natural wood, linen, soft pastels, white walls; farmhouse, cottage or rustic rooms

Type: square tabletop planter with stand
Use: holding a small plant on a table, shelf or desk; living room, home office, bedroom
Style: modern, minimalist, glam
Materials: matte ceramic pot, copper-finished metal wire stand
Colors: light grey, rose copper
Shape: tapered square pot lifted in an open cubic wire frame, compact, light and open
Feel: fresh, neat, modern
Goes with: white or blush walls, marble, succulents; modern or Scandinavian rooms

Type: rectangular ceramic window sill planter
Use: growing herbs or succulents on a window sill or shelf; living room, home office, kitchen window
Style: contemporary, rustic, coastal
Materials: glossy reactive glazed ceramic, textured matte base
Colors: light sea green, dark slate blue-grey
Shape: long narrow trough with flared sides, two-tone band, low and compact
Feel: fresh, earthy, calm
Goes with: white walls, natural wood, green plants; coastal or contemporary rooms

Type: patterned stoneware plant pot
Use: holding an indoor plant on a table, shelf or floor; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: modern, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: glazed stoneware with printed lattice pattern
Colors: off-white, cool grey
Shape: cylindrical pot on a small recessed foot, geometric triangle lattice, compact, medium weight
Feel: crisp, calm, graphic
Goes with: light wood, white or grey walls, green foliage; Scandinavian or modern rooms

Type: rustic stoneware plant pot
Use: holding an indoor plant on a table, shelf or sill; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: bohemian, rustic, Japandi
Materials: speckled stoneware, partly white glazed, raw clay base
Colors: warm white, tan brown
Shape: cylindrical pot with narrower raw clay base, rows of dashes and dots in tribal pattern, compact
Feel: earthy, warm, handmade
Goes with: rattan, jute, natural wood, terracotta; bohemian or Japandi rooms
